        with the Procedure for Control of Defective Goods

        轉，以便日後追回及更換不合格產品

        成前識別潛在問題

Risk Management
風險管理

24      The objective of climate-related financial disclosures on risk management is to enable users of general purpose
        financial reports to understand an entity’s processes to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor climate-related risks
        and opportunities, including whether and how those processes are integrated into and inform the entity’s overall risk
        management process.
        在風險管理方面，氣候相關財務信息披露的目標是使通用目的財務報告使用者了解主體識別、評估、優先考慮和監控氣
        候相關風險和機遇的流程，包括這些流程是否以及如何被整合至並影響主體的整體風險管理流程。
25      To achieve this objective, an entity shall disclose information about:   Tackling Climate Change – Strategy and Risk
                                                                                 Management
        為實現此目標，主體應披露以下信息：                                                        應對氣候變化－策略及風險管理
25(a)   The processes and related policies the entity uses to identify,
        assess, prioritise and monitor climate-related risks, including
        information about
        主體用於識別、評估、優先考慮和監控氣候相關風險的流程和相關
        政策，包括以下信息：
        (i)    the inputs and parameters the entity uses;
               主體使用的輸入值和參數；
        (ii)   whether and how the entity uses climate-related scenario
               analysis to inform its identification of climate-related risks;
               主體是否以及如何使用氣候相關情景分析來幫助識別其氣
               候相關風險；
        (iii)  how the entity assesses the nature, likelihood and
               magnitude of the effects of those risks;
               主體如何評估這些風險影響的性質、可能性和量級；
        (iv)   whether and how the entity prioritises climate-related risks
               relative to other types of risk;

                    Contingent liabilities                                                    或有負債

                    A contingent liability is a present obligation arising                    或有負債指因過往事件而引
                    from past events but is not recognised because it is                      致 的 現 有 責 任，但 由 於 可 能 不
                    not probable that an outflow of resources embodying                       需要流出含經濟利益的資源
                    economic benefits will be required to settle the obligation               以 結 付 責 任，或 責 任 金 額 未 能
                    or the amount of the obligation cannot be measured with                   充 份 可 靠 計 量 而 未 有 確 認。
                    sufficient reliability.

                    Where the Group is jointly and severally liable for an                    如本集團須共同及個別承擔
                    obligation, the part of the obligation that is expected to                某 項 責 任，該 項 責 任 中 預 期 由
                    be met by other parties is treated as a contingent liability              另一方承擔的部分則以或有
                    and it is not recognised in the consolidated financial                    負 債 處 理，且 毋 須 於 綜 合 財 務
                    statements.                                                               報 表 中 予 以 確 認。

                    The Group assesses continually to determine whether an                    本集團持續評估以釐定帶有
                    outflow of resources embodying economic benefits has                      經濟利益的資源流出是否已
                    become probable. If it becomes probable that an outflow                   成 為 可 能。倘 有 需 要 就 一 項 先
                    of future economic benefits will be required for an item                  前作為或有負債處理之項目
                    previously dealt with as a contingent liability, a provision              流 出 未 來 經 濟 利 益，則 於 可 能
                    is recognised in the consolidated financial statements in                 出現變動的報告年度之綜合
                    the reporting period in which the change in probability                   財 務 報 表 內 確 認 撥 備（除 非 出
                    occurs, except in the extremely rare circumstances where                  現極端罕見情況而未能作出
                    no reliable estimate can be made.                                         可 靠 估 算）。
